%C A055246 Both conjectures of Jeffery are true and follow from a(n) = 1 + 6*A005836(n): A005836 is generated by 0, c -> 3c, c -> 3c+1, and 3*(1+6c) - 2 = 1 + 6*(3c), 3*(1+6c) + 4 = 1 + 6*(3c+1); A191107(n) = 1 + 3*A005836(n) and A003278(n) = A005836(n) + 1; and the binary expansion of (2n-1)*2^(k-1) - 1 is that of n-1 followed by 0 and k-1 ones, so A005836((2n-1)*2^(k-1)) = 3^k*A005836(n) + (3^(k-1)-1)/2. - _Joaquim Manji-Jung_, Nov 18 2026
